Hi Andrea, 


Since I haven’t heard back after your Wisq demo request before the new year, I put down 30 mins for us next week to share how other HR teams are winning with agentic AI.

As a quick refresher: Harper, our AI HR generalist, helps automate policy Q&, HR transactions, and other time-consuming admin tasks. 

If this time (Tues 2/3 at 10am PST) doesn’t work, feel free to move it to something that does.
